Class ServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.Socket.ServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ServerHandler extends Object implements Runnable
The ServerHandler class is responsible for handling communication between the client and the server. It manages input and output streams, processes incoming messages from the server, and forwards them to the appropriate components of the client. It also allows for sending messages to the server.

The class uses an executor service to process incoming messages concurrently and asynchronously.

This class handles the setup of the connection and allows interaction with the server's messages.
